label: TP
reason: User input from cookie flows through doSomething() preserving content via double-base64 encode/decode, then concatenates directly into LDAP filter string at line 104 before being executed by ctx.search() at line 79. The encodeForHTML() call at line 105 protects the response display but does not prevent the LDAP injection vulnerability at the search sink.

evidence.note: cookie value flows to ldap filter without proper sanitization before search execution
double base64 encode/decode preserves user input in bar variable
